(https), note?, lines: [{ lineNo, qty }] }. Only goods lines (lineType goods) ordered by quantity ship; a service line is confirmed with a service entry sheet. Sending a shipmentId again replaces that shipment; status canceled withdraws it (404 SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND if there is none) and needs no lines. The buyer's requester and receiver are told of a new shipment or a new status, and the buyer's sync feed gets purchase_order.shipped. Never a receipt: the buyer still confirms what arrives. Only an open order (awaiting_fulfillment or invoiced), except to withdraw; 409 ORDER_NOT_OPEN otherwise. Takes the same ?buyer= as GetPurchaseOrder. An API key needs the orders:fulfill scope.

get.summary: [Both] What changed, oldest first, to keep another system in step: { events: [{ id, at, type, documentType, documentId, buyerWorkspaceId? }], nextCursor, hasMore }. A supplier gets purchase_order.issued|changed|canceled|rejected, invoice.received|approved|rejected|paid|payment_withdrawn|remittance_sent|credit_applied, invoice.updated (the buyer holds the invoice for review, or the hold is over: GetInvoiceStatus says which) and credit_note.accepted|rejected; a buyer gets invoice.received and credit_note.received (a supplier sent one), invoice.updated (an approval step approved it, including an automatic approval, it was rejected, or its supplier confirmed bank details or reported it), invoice.payment (a payment was recorded or withdrawn, credit or a zero amount settled it, or a payment through Pleaxy succeeded, failed or was released: read GetInvoiceRemittance), purchase_order.updated (approved, rejected or canceled), and purchase_order.confirmed / purchase_order.shipped (the supplier confirmed or shipped against it: read GetPurchaseOrderFulfillment). An event names the document only: read it with GetPurchaseOrder, GetPurchaseOrderDocument, GetInvoiceStatus or GetInvoiceRemittance (pass buyerWorkspaceId as ?buyer=). Pass nextCursor back as ?after= on the next call; call again at once while hasMore is true. ?limit= 1-500 (default 100). Events are kept 30 days and delivered at least once; the newest 5 seconds wait for the next call. A buyer sees only the document types its procurement role can view.

info.title: Pleaxy API
info.description: PO-to-payment lifecycle: purchase orders, usage-based matching, settlement. Each endpoint is tagged **[Buyer]**, **[Supplier]**, or **[Both]** for which side of the workspace calls it. To say which side you act as, put a Workspace ID in the path: `<regionId>.buyer` or `<regionId>.supplier`. With a bare region id, someone who holds both a buyer and a supplier profile in that region acts as the buyer.

servers.description: One workspace's API. The SDK clients build this from baseUrl and workspaceId.

workspaceId.description: Company profile → Workspace ID in the Pleaxy console.

procurementRole.description: Buyer-side procurement authority the key grants. Defaults to `read-only`. `agent` is for an AI agent or integration that raises purchase orders and enters invoices: it reads contracts, suppliers and questionnaires, and changes no approval rule, auto-approval or billing. Minting requires `edit` on `approvalSettings` (i.e. an administrator). Ignored for supplier-side keys.

supplierRole.description: Supplier-side keys: the role the key acts with, as people have - administrator, accounts-receivable, sales, fulfillment or read-only. Defaults to `read-only`. invoices:feed needs a role that edits invoices (administrator, accounts-receivable); orders:fulfill one that edits orders (administrator, fulfillment). Ignored for buyer-side keys.

scopes.description: Extra abilities, each for one side (the other side's scope is a 400). Supplier: `invoices:feed` lets the key submit invoices to a connected buyer through POST .../invoices/connections/:connectionId; `orders:fulfill` lets it confirm orders and send ship notices, through POST .../purchase-orders/:poId/confirmations and .../ship-notices or as cXML to POST /v1/cxml/fulfillment. Buyer: `payments:record` lets the key record payments made outside Pleaxy through POST .../invoices/payment-records, and needs a procurementRole that can edit invoices. A scoped key keeps every other ability of its side. Only an administrator can mint a scoped key.

detail.description: Buyer-typed account identifier for a demo (simulated) connection - required for azure, optional for gcp/oci. Ignored by a real connector: AWS derives the account ID from AssumeRole, GCP the billing account ID from the export, OCI shows the verified tenancy.

roleArn.description: AWS only, required - the IAM Role ARN the buyer created in their own account (via the CloudFormation/CDK/CLI script from POST .../cloud-connections/aws/init) and pasted back here.

awsConnectionId.description: AWS only, required - the connectionId returned by POST .../cloud-connections/aws/init, linking this verify call back to the externalId generated server-side for that pending connection. Never the externalId itself - that's looked up server-side, never trusted from the client.

gcpConnectionId.description: Google Cloud only, when its connector is on - the connectionId returned by POST .../cloud-connections/gcp/init. The binding itself is looked up server-side, never taken from the client.

gcpProjectNumber.description: Google Cloud only - the export project's number (digits).

gcpServiceAccountEmail.description: Google Cloud only - the service account the setup script created, in the export project.

gcpExportTable.description: Google Cloud only - project.dataset.gcp_billing_export_v1_XXXXXX_XXXXXX_XXXXXX (standard usage cost export).

ociConnectionId.description: OCI only, when its connector is on - the connectionId returned by POST .../cloud-connections/oci/init. The key pair is looked up server-side, never taken from the client.

ociUserOcid.description: OCI only - the OCID of the pleaxy-billing user the setup script created (ocid1.user.oc1..…).

ociHomeRegion.description: OCI only - the tenancy's home region, one of the regions POST .../oci/init lists.

azureConnectionId.description: Azure only, when its connector is on - the connectionId returned by POST .../cloud-connections/azure/init. The audience is looked up server-side, never taken from the client.

azureBillingAccountId.description: Azure only - the billing account of the billing profile picked from POST .../azure/discover (<guid>:<guid>_YYYY-MM-DD).

azureBillingProfileId.description: Azure only - the billing profile picked from POST .../azure/discover.

azureTenantId.description: Not accepted here: verify uses only the tenant ID that POST .../azure/discover proved. Declared so that a request carrying it is refused (400) rather than silently stripped.

azureClientId.description: Not accepted here, like azureTenantId: verify uses only the app (client) ID discover proved.

dataSources.description: What Pleaxy may read through this connection: `invoices` (finalized invoices) and/or `current_cost` (month-to-date cost). Omitted: both. Pleaxy never calls the provider for a source left out, including on a manual sync - some providers bill the customer per request for current-period cost (AWS Cost Explorer).

azureConnectionId.description: The connectionId returned by POST .../cloud-connections/azure/init. The audience is looked up server-side, never taken from the client.

azureTenantId.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant the app was registered in (GUID).

azureBillingAccountId.description: The Microsoft Customer Agreement billing account ID (<guid>:<guid>_YYYY-MM-DD). Read directly: an app with only Billing profile reader can't list billing accounts.

azureBillingProfileId.description: The billing profile ID the app has Billing profile reader on.

approverEmployeeKey.description: Employee key (Cognito sub) of the approver. Required and non-empty: a step is actionable only by the employee it names. There is no 'unassigned' step.

operator.description: gt/gte/lt/lte for amount; is/is_not for supplier, requester, costCenter, glCode, requestType and answer.

value.description: A number for amount (in the region's currency), a supplier Workspace ID for supplier, an employee key for requester, a code on the workspace's cost center list for costCenter, a GL account for glCode (the order's own, else its cost center's), a request type id (rt_...) for requestType, an option id for answer.

questionId.description: answer only: the question tested, as <requestTypeId>/<fieldId> (a yes/no or choice question on that request type); value is one of its option ids (yes/no for a yes/no question). requestType and answer conditions go on the purchase_request flow only.

label.description: Human label for the group as a whole, e.g. 'Risk review' - falls back to stage labels joined when absent.

conditions.description: Include this step only when every condition matches the document. Absent or empty = always. The chain must keep at least one step with no conditions.

useDefault.description: Replace the chain with the region's default: one step, 'Region administrator', naming the region's owning administrator (or the first administrator by name). Can't be combined with groups, stages or linkedTo.

linkedTo.description: Link this process's chain to another process's configured groups, instead of having its own

stages.description: Legacy flat shape, one sequential stage per step - still accepted for backward compatibility. Prefer `groups`; sending this persists as an equivalent single-stage-per-group chain. When sent, must have at least one stage - an empty chain would mean zero human approval.

groups.description: Sequential across groups, parallel (AND-all-required) within a group. When sent, must have at least one group - an empty chain would mean zero human approval.

supplierWorkspaceId.description: The supplier account the rule applies to, as its Workspace ID (e.g. `reg_01k5….supplier`).

supplierContains.description: Legacy: supplier-name substring. Matches only documents whose supplier has no account; use supplierWorkspaceId for any supplier on Pleaxy.

id.description: Omit to create a new rule - the server assigns an id.

billingCurrency.description: "Bills in": the currency a supplier with no Pleaxy account invoices you in, the default for new orders and invoices to it. Refused for a supplier with an account, whose own currencies rule. null removes it (your currency is then the default).

paymentCurrency.description: "Pay in": the currency you usually pay this supplier in, the default payment currency on its new invoices. For a supplier with an account, one it accepts. null removes it.

enabled.description: true lets this supplier send invoices with an invoices:feed API key; false stops the next one

fileId.description: The fileId the upload-url route returned

companyName.description: The company the supplier invoices. Defaults to the buyer's company name.

taxId.description: That company's tax id (VAT number, CUIT, EIN...). None when left out.

lineType.description: goods (delivered: shipped and confirmed on a goods receipt) or service (performed: confirmed on a service entry sheet, never shipped). Defaults to the catalog item's type, else to service for a service scope or a time unit and goods otherwise.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Optional - the server writes the order's currency on every line. If sent, it must be the order's currency (any case); another currency is a 400, since Pleaxy doesn't convert currencies.

paymentTerms.description: The line's payment terms, e.g. "Net 30". Optional: left out (or blank), the line takes the default payment terms of the contract it was priced from or the order names (contractId), else the catalog item's, else "Net 30".

dueDate.description: When the goods or the work on this line are due (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. a statement-of-work milestone. On a 3-way order, its receiver is reminded when it passes with nothing received.

customerLineNo.description: The buyer's own number for this line (e.g. from their ERP), up to 40 characters. Optional, like poNumber; stored and shown alongside the server's lineNo, never replacing it.

quoteLineNo.description: The line of the order's quote (quoteImportId) this line was filled from, when Pleaxy read the quote. Kept on the line; the app shows the line as priced from the supplier's quote unless a contract rate priced it.

sowLineNo.description: The milestone or deliverable of the order's statement of work (sowImportId) this line was filled from, when Pleaxy read the SOW. Kept on the line, provenance only, like quoteLineNo.

punchoutRef.description: The online-store cart line this line came from (store punchout spec D4). The server reads that cart's evidence and sets what the line is - its name, unit and part numbers - from it; only qty and unitPrice are yours.

poNumber.description: Custom PO number to use as this PO's id instead of an auto-generated one (e.g. 'PO-2026-0042'). Must be unique within the region.

matching.description: How the order's invoices are matched: two_way against the order and its contract; three_way also against what was received (goods receipts and service entry sheets). Defaults to what the workspace's matching setting suggests (GET .../matching-policy). Refused for a cloud provider's order, which is matched against usage, and, when the setting lets only administrators change it, for anything but the default from anyone else.

receiverEmployeeKey.description: Who confirms delivery: someone in this workspace, by employee key. Defaults to whoever raises the order. Used with three_way matching.

supplierRegionId.description: regionId of the onboarded supplier org this PO is issued to, if known. The buyer must hold an approved SupplierConnection to this supplier; the server rejects a region it isn't connected to. Links the PO to that org's real supplier workspace instead of just its free-text `supplier` name - see WorkspacesService.getSupplierWorkspace.

supplierConnectionId.description: The id of a supplier on your Suppliers list (not rejected, not a cloud provider) this PO is for - see GET .../suppliers. One approved with a Pleaxy account is treated as its supplierRegionId. Any other (not invited yet, invited, onboarding) is named by its record: its invoices match the PO by id, the PO is emailed to its contact, and sending it invites a supplier not invited yet. The record's name replaces `supplier`. Not with supplierRegionId, provider or supplierContactEmail.

currency.description: ISO 4217: the currency the order is priced in. To a supplier with an account (supplierRegionId), one its region prices in, its main currency by default (400 PO_CURRENCY_NOT_OFFERED otherwise). To a cloud provider or a supplier not on Pleaxy yet, any code; by default that supplier's "Bills in" currency, else your workspace's. An order in a currency other than your workspace's goes through every approval step and is never auto-approved.

payerAccounts.description: Only with `provider`: this region's cloud connections of that provider the PO applies to, by `id`. A connection still being set up is refused. The PO stores each connection's own label and detail; any sent here are ignored.

billToParty.description: Who the supplier invoices, when it isn't the buyer's company profile billing details. Left out, the order copies those details as they are now (company name, billing address, tax id).

billTo.description: Use `billToParty`. A one-line bill-to address for the buyer's company, kept as typed; ignored when `billToParty` is sent.

costCenter.description: The cost center: when the workspace keeps a cost center list, a code or name on it (stored as the list's code; a closed one is refused); otherwise free text. An empty string clears it.

glCode.description: The GL account (spend category) the order books to, when it isn't its cost center's. Approval steps can route by it. An empty string clears it.

blanket.description: A blanket order: billed as used, up to its amount. Its amount never uses the cost center's budget at once; expectedMonthly does, month by month, and its invoices as they are approved. Cloud-provider orders are blanket orders either way.

stageId.description: Id of the pending stage to reassign. May be in any group, not only the current one.

approverEmployeeKey.description: Employee key (Cognito sub) of the new approver. Must be a buyer member of this workspace, and not the acting administrator.

reason.description: Why the step was reassigned - shown in the approval history.

warningPct.description: Percent, 0–100: how far an invoice's stated rate may be from the reference before it's flagged.

unitPrice.description: 0 or more, at most 1,000,000,000. A reduction is a discount, never a negative price.

discount.description: Total discount on this line, with no more decimal places than the buyer's currency allows (at most 2). It can't be more than qty × unitPrice + charge. The line amount is qty × unitPrice + charge − discount.

charge.description: Total charges on this line (freight, handling…), with no more decimal places than the buyer's currency allows (at most 2).

description.description: What the discount or charge is for, 1–200 characters

amount.description: A positive amount, with no more decimal places than the buyer's currency allows (at most 2). `type` says whether it reduces or adds to the total.

description.description: What the entry is, e.g. "IVA" or "Percepción IIBB CABA". 1–200 characters.

amount.description: 0 or more, in the currency of the object it belongs to.

rate.description: A percentage, 0–100, when the entry has one (IVA 21). Omit for fixed amounts.

kind.description: prepayment: the buyer already paid it (a deposit, an advance). credit: the seller applied a credit it holds (prepaid or promotional credits).

description.description: What it is, e.g. "30% deposit" or "AWS promotional credit". 1–200 characters.

amount.description: More than 0, in the invoice's currency, including tax. With the withholdings, less than the invoice total.

sourceInvoiceId.description: Prepayment only: the paid Pleaxy invoice it was - a deposit on the same purchase order from the same supplier. Its payment reference and date are filled in, and the purchase order isn't drawn twice for it.

reference.description: The payment's reference, or the seller's id for the credit. 1–64 characters. A prepayment needs this or sourceInvoiceId.

paidOn.description: Prepayment only: when it was paid, YYYY-MM-DD.

breakdown.description: At most 20. Must sum to totalAmount.

sourceCurrencyCode.description: The invoice's currency. Filled in when omitted.

targetCurrencyCode.description: This object's currencyCode. Filled in when omitted.

rate.description: 1 source = rate target, as printed on the invoice. Greater than 0.

rateDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the rate applies to. Not in the future, and at most one day after the invoice date.

rateSource.description: Where the rate comes from, as the invoice says, e.g. "Banco Nación" or "AWS". Up to 80 characters.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217. Must differ from the invoice's currency.

totalAmount.description: Required on paymentCurrencyAmount: the amount owed in this currency. Optional on taxCurrencyAmount.

method.description: bank_transfer needs iban or accountNumber. wire needs iban or accountNumber, plus bic or routingNumber. ach needs accountNumber and a 9-digit ABA routingNumber. check needs mailingAddress. other needs notes.

payeeName.description: The account holder, or the payee on a check. 1–140 characters.

iban.description: Spaces allowed; stored uppercase without them. Must pass the IBAN check digits.

accountNumber.description: Letters, digits, spaces and '-', at most 34 characters

routingNumber.description: ABA routing number, sort code, BSB or similar: digits, spaces and '-', at most 20 characters

mailingAddress.description: Where to mail a check. At most 300 characters.

paymentReference.description: What the buyer should quote with the payment. At most 140 characters.

notes.description: Anything else the buyer needs to pay. At most 500 characters.

documentType.description: "debit_note" for an amendment that raises what an invoice asked for (credit notes spec §18): it names the invoice it amends and takes its buyer, supplier, currency and PO. "invoice" or absent: an invoice.

amendsInvoiceId.description: Debit note: the Pleaxy id of the invoice it amends (or amendsInvoiceNumber).

amendsInvoiceNumber.description: Debit note: the supplier's number of the invoice it amends, when the Pleaxy id isn't known (the feed's way).

replacesInvoiceIds.description: A replacement invoice (credit and rebill, credit notes spec §20): the Pleaxy ids of the invoices and debit notes it replaces, 1–20, all from this supplier. Or replacesInvoiceNumbers.

replacesInvoiceNumbers.description: A replacement invoice: the supplier's numbers of the invoices it replaces, when the Pleaxy ids aren't known (the feed's way). 1–20.

poId.description: An open PO between exactly this buyer and supplier

invoiceNumber.description: Unique per supplier within the buyer's workspace, case-insensitively

invoiceDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD - not in the future, not more than 365 days back

poLineNo.description: The purchase order line this invoice bills (its lineNo), when it is against a PO. An invoice bills one PO line, stated here and never on its lines, and all of its lines are held to it. Lines are never matched by description. Against a one-line PO, an invoice without one bills that line. Against a multi-line PO, an invoice naming no line makes it a discrepancy a person must resolve. A lineNo the PO doesn't have is refused. Not with billsNoPoLine.

billsNoPoLine.description: true when the invoice bills none of the PO's lines (an unordered extra, a one-off fee). It draws on the PO's balance only, and the invoice always needs a person's approval. Not with poLineNo. Shipping and handling usually belong in adjustments instead.

adjustments.description: Invoice-level discounts and charges, before tax. At most 20.

sourceImportId.description: Buyer only: the invoice import (POST .../invoice-imports) this invoice was recorded from. Its document is kept with the invoice when it is a PDF under 8 MB, and the import records the invoice.

taxAmount.description: Total tax on the invoice, as stated by the supplier. It is included in the invoice total. Pleaxy doesn't calculate tax.

taxBreakdown.description: Tax by type in the invoice's currency, e.g. IVA 21% and a percepción. Must sum to taxAmount, which is then required. At most 20.

withholdings.description: Amounts the invoice withholds from its total, in the invoice's currency, e.g. ISR retenido 10%. Positive; they reduce what's owed, never the total. Less than the total in all. At most 20.

invoiceKind.description: "prepayment" for an invoice that bills a deposit (UBL InvoiceTypeCode 386). Its payment can later be deducted from the final invoice.

deductions.description: What was already paid towards the invoice after tax: deposits and advances the buyer paid, and credits the seller applied. They reduce what's owed, never the total or its tax. With the withholdings, less than the total. At most 20.

paymentCurrencyAmount.description: Only when the invoice names the amount owed in another currency (e.g. AWS billing in ARS): that amount, with the rate printed on the invoice. Leave it off when the invoice is converted at the payment-date rate. Pleaxy checks the figures against the rate and never converts anything itself.

taxCurrencyAmount.description: Tax as stated in the legal currency of the buyer's country, when that isn't the invoice's currency. Needs taxAmount. Display only.
